ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels occupy approximately 80-85% of the visible ventral area, while low-intensity (black) pixels are concentrated on the margins and central notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white central field. Continuous black pigmentation band mapping along the entire trailing edge and fluke tips. Large dark irregular cluster at the median notch. Discrete dark focal spots detected: one prominent circular blotch on the left lobe and smaller clusters on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression; pixel angle estimated at 45-55 degrees, with a bounding-box depth approximately 1/6th of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration across the entire trailing boundary. Continuous peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 25 pixels, creating a jagged profile isolated from the water line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward sweep trajectory. The trailing edges exhibit a strong concave curve toward the distal tips, while leading edges appear relatively linear.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of several small dark circular pixel clusters on the left lobe. A concentrated irregular dark cluster is present at the confluence of the two lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned horizontal linear pixel disruptions visible on the inner-left lobe surface, breaking the primary white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular serration/erosion of the trailing edges on both lobes. Significant dark traumatic pigmentation or scarring localized at the base of the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct hook-shaped dark pigmentation mark is visible on the far left lobe, proximal to the leading edge.
